text: Mary Gibson leaves her boarding school to find her missing sister Jacqueline, and above an Italian restaurant in Greenwich Village finds [a rented room holding only a chair and a noose|images|ropes, cages and executions]. The trail leads to the Palladists, [devil worshippers among Jacqueline's old co-workers|origin|secret worshippers among us], whose law says [any member who betrays the cult must die|rules|break the rule and pay]. A detective is stabbed in the dark, a corpse rides the subway, and the cultists spend a long night urging Jacqueline toward [a glass of poison|images|food, drink and drugs].
